# Amazon Q — captured 2026-08-23
# Sources: docs.aws.amazon.com/amazonq/latest/qdeveloper-ug/doc-history.html
#          docs.aws.amazon.com/amazonq/latest/qbusiness-ug/doc-history.html

## STATUS: DEAD SOURCE, NOW FORMALLY DYING. Second consecutive scan recommending demotion.

### Q Developer doc history — newest entries
- **END OF SUPPORT NOTICE — August 17, 2026.** "On April 30, 2027, AWS will discontinue support for
  Amazon Q Developer IDE plugins. For capabilities similar to Amazon Q Developer IDE plugins, explore
  **Kiro** to access the latest models and features, including **agentic coding, chat and MCP
  support**." Migration page: "everything you rely on today (inline suggestions, chat, and code
  generation) is available in Kiro." -> kiro.dev/docs/upgrade-guides/migrating-from-q-developer/
  (The deprecation itself is NOT reportable. The NAMED SUCCESSOR is — see below.)
- Newest actual FEATURE entry: **May 21, 2026** — `q:CreateArtifact`, `q:GetArtifact`,
  `q:GetArtifactActionResult`, `q:PerformArtifactAction` added to AmazonQFullAccess /
  AmazonQDeveloperAccess for Amazon Q artifacts (preview).
- Then: Mar 19 2026 (Builder ID unsubscribe), Feb 18 2026 (subscription account limit 10 -> 20).
  ~3 months with no feature movement.

### Q Business — frozen
Closed to new customers **2026-07-31**. Newest FEATURE entry remains **Agentic RAG, August 14, 2025**
— over a year old.

## ===== TWO NAMED SUCCESSORS, BOTH ABSENT FROM sources.json =====

**1. KIRO** (new this scan) — an agentic IDE. Squarely inside ENDPOINT's remit:
  - "**one unified agent harness that powers every surface (IDE, CLI, Web, and Mobile)**" — one
    configuration follows the developer across four form factors.
  - **Custom agents**: config files carry an **`mcpServers` field naming which MCP servers that agent
    may reach**, a `tools` field selecting individual tools per source, and `toolAliases` for naming
    conflicts. Per-agent tool grants are declarative, file-based and ENUMERABLE.
  - **MCP config at BOTH workspace and user scope** (`Kiro: Open workspace MCP config (JSON)` /
    `Open user MCP config (JSON)`).
  - **HOT-RELOAD:** a file watcher on `.kiro/agents` directories and `mcp.json` applies changes on
    save with **no session restart** => an agent's capability set changes mid-session with no UI
    event. Defeats point-in-time capability inventory (same failure mode as Anthropic's
    repository-mounted skills, reported 2026-08-09).
  - This is an INHERITED installed base, not organic adoption — AWS is pushing a population onto it
    by a known date (2027-04-30).
  Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/mcp/ , /docs/mcp/configuration/ , /docs/custom-agents/ ,
        /docs/custom-agents/configuration-reference/ , https://github.com/kirodotdev/Kiro
                                                    [reported 2026-08-23, MEDIUM/ENDPOINT]

**2. AMAZON QUICK** (flagged 2026-08-21) — AWS points Q Business users here. Still never scanned.

## RECOMMENDATION (repeated)
Demote Amazon Q from primary-tier polling and add Kiro (`kiro.dev/docs` + changelog) plus an Amazon
Quick source. Otherwise primary-tier budget confirms a dead product weekly while BOTH of its
successors go unwatched — one of which is an agentic IDE with hot-reloading MCP grants.

Updated: 2026-08-23 — EOL notice dated Aug 17 is new; Kiro identified and reported as the unwatched
successor.
